purpose: Determine whether the final frozen S0 sky coordinate can locate the same source directly in the corrected reconstructed tile WCS with enough pixel accuracy to scale pixel-morphology measurements without rerunning Source Extractor and PSFEx for every S0 source. This is an engineering/provenance gate, not an astrophysical hypothesis test.

frozen_validation_sample.truth_centroid: Exact replayed pass2 XWIN_IMAGE/YWIN_IMAGE for NUMBER == frozen object_id from the admitted B3S sidecar.
frozen_validation_sample.query_coordinate: Frozen final S0 ra/dec from release results/s0-642-20260814; no source recentering before the comparison.

locator_under_test.step_1: Reconstruct the exact frozen 60-arcmin tile from its named POSS-I plate using the same 7x7 pixel-space grid and same frozen per-plate CRPIX correction used by B2/B3/B3S.
locator_under_test.step_2: Read only the reconstructed corrected tile WCS; do not run pass1, PSFEx or pass2 for the locator prediction.
locator_under_test.step_3: Transform frozen S0 ra/dec to zero-indexed tile pixel coordinates using the corrected tile WCS.
locator_under_test.step_4: Compare the predicted pixel to the independently replayed exact pass2 centroid after converting XWIN_IMAGE/YWIN_IMAGE from SExtractor one-indexed coordinates to zero-indexed coordinates.

predeclared_gates.tile_reconstruction: All 52 frozen distinct tiles must reconstruct with the exact B2/B3 tile identity machinery.
predeclared_gates.truth_lineage: 64/64 B3S rows must have exact NUMBER recovery and finite pass2 XWIN_IMAGE/YWIN_IMAGE.
predeclared_gates.locator_coverage: 64/64 S0 sky coordinates must transform to finite corrected-tile pixel coordinates.
predeclared_gates.primary_accuracy: At least 95% of the 64 sources must have Euclidean predicted-vs-pass2 centroid offset <= 3.0 pixels.
predeclared_gates.catastrophic_tail: 100% of the 64 sources must have offset <= 8.0 pixels.
report_only: offset converted to approximate arcsec using local WCS pixel scale
per-tile and per-plate failures if any

forbidden_inputs: Blue Book or other human-report labels

post_pass_scaleout.name: JPFM-2F-C1-LABEL-BLIND-PIXEL-MORPHOLOGY-SIDECAR-SCALEOUT
post_pass_scaleout.principle: Use direct corrected-tile WCS localization plus local pixel measurements for a much larger or full S0 morphology release, while retaining exact tile/plate lineage and keeping all external labels sealed until the morphology manifest and clusters are frozen.
